get.summary: Logs in a user via Discord
get.description:
Exchanges the authorization code received from Discord (via the standard
authorization-code flow) for a Caliborn JWT.

The frontend redirects the user to the
[Discord authorization URL](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/oauth2#authorization-code-flow);
Discord redirects back with `?code=...`; the frontend then calls this
endpoint with that code as a query parameter.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The authorization code received from Discord after the user has authorized your application.

401.description: An authorization error occurred (e.g. invalid authorization code)

get.summary: Subscribe to the realtime event stream.
get.description:
This is a WebSocket endpoint. OpenAPI cannot describe a WebSocket session —
3.1 has no concept of one and 3.2 only added Server-Sent Events — so what is
documented here is the **handshake**: the `GET` that upgrades, its
query-param auth, and the `101` response. Once upgraded, the server pushes
JSON-encoded [`crate::realtime::Event`] values (`now_playing`,
`queue_updated`), discriminated by their `type` field, and never reads from
the client except to answer pings.

101.description: Switching Protocols — the WebSocket session is open and will stream `realtime::Event` values as JSON text frames

400.description: Not a valid WebSocket upgrade request

401.description: Missing, duplicated, or invalid `token`/`apikey` query parameter

ErrorResponse.description: An error response containing details about the problem

error.description:
A machine-readable error code identifying the error type.

Common values include "Bad Request", "Unauthorized", "Internal Server Error",
and "Not Found".

message.description: A human-readable message describing the error.

FieldMeta.description:
One column of an admin resource, as reported by
`GET /admin/crud/{resource}/_schema`.

amount.description: Amount of boonbucks to send. Must be > 0.

recipient_id.description: Discord user ID of the recipient.

PayResponse.description: Result of a successful pay transfer

ProfileDto.description: Aggregated profile view of a user.

cans_added.description: Number of cans this user has placed in Can Town.

permissions.description: Effective permissions (role grants + per-user grants − per-user revokes).

opponent_id.description: Discord user ID of the opponent.

priority.description:
If true, push to the priority queue (`prioq`) instead of the standard
request queue (`srq`).

bet.description: Wager in boonbucks. Must be between 1 and 10 inclusive.

StreamlabsRecord.description:
One row from a Streamlabs Chatbot export. Fields use serde aliases so the
loader accepts both the modern (`Name`, `UserID`, `Hours`, `Points`) and
snake-case shapes commonly seen in older exports.

boonbucks.description:
The amount of boonbucks (virtual currency) the user has accumulated.

Boonbucks can be earned through various activities on the platform and
can be used for purchases or interactions.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the user account was created.

id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

last_message_sent.description:
The timestamp of the last message sent by the user.

This is `None` if the user has never sent a message.

migrated.description:
Whether the user has migrated their data from the old radio bot.

This is `true` if the user has migrated their data from the old radio bot.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the user account was last updated.

username.description:
The username of the user, if they have set one.

This is `None` if the user has not set a username yet.

watched_time.description:
The total watched time of the user, in seconds.

This represents the cumulative time the user has spent watching content
on the lumiRadio platform.

UserToken.description: A response to a successful login via Discord

expires_at.description: The timestamp when the access token expires.

expires_in.description: The time in seconds until the access token expires.

token.description:
An access token which can be used to authenticate to other endpoints.
This is a JWT token containing the user's identity information.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who was logged in.
